rubric.rating_rule: Rate each axis independently and relative to the source's stated target claim. Never infer independence from a different hostname, publisher prestige, or citation count.

A3.label: thing itself
A3.rule: The source is the exact normative artifact, code, dataset, decision record, or first-party incident record that constitutes the claim.
A3.tie_break: Source code is A3 only for the behavior of that exact revision; a first-party incident report is A3 only for the operator's own incident.

A2.label: maintainer or operator
A2.rule: A maintainer, issuer, or operator explains the thing it controls, but the page is explanatory rather than the constitutive artifact itself.
A2.tie_break: Official branding alone is insufficient; the author must maintain or operate the subject of the target claim.

A1.label: practitioner
A1.rule: An implementer, user, or affected party reports its own practice, measurement, or reproduction without governing the subject.
A1.tie_break: A practitioner can be highly competent and still remain A1 when speaking about somebody else's standard or system.

A0.label: re-teller
A0.rule: An aggregator, tutorial, index, mirror, or commentator repeats or interprets material without stewardship of the subject or a first-hand observation.
A0.tie_break: Repository ownership of a copied document does not confer authority over the copied document's originating standard.

I3.label: original observation or artifact
I3.rule: The source is original evidence: a normative artifact, direct dataset, executable code path, decision record, or first-party measurement that can be checked directly.
I3.tie_break: Originality is claim-relative; a direct artifact may still be derivative evidence for a broader claim it does not measure.

I2.label: independent analysis or reproduction
I2.rule: The source adds material evidence through its own implementation, measurement, reproduction, or analysis rather than merely restating an upstream source.
I2.tie_break: A separately implemented code path can be I2 even when it implements the same public specification.

I1.label: derivative synthesis
I1.rule: The source organizes or interprets identifiable upstream material and adds reasoning or guidance, but adds no new observation that tests the claim.
I1.tie_break: Useful explanation is not independent corroboration unless it introduces a separately obtained signal.

I0.label: copy, mirror, or pure restatement
I0.rule: The source is verbatim or near-verbatim syndication, a mirror, or a pure restatement and contributes no independent observation.
I0.tie_break: Exact or normalized-content identity forces I0 for every member of the copy family, regardless of domains or publishers.

copy_override.rule: If two or more panel sources have identical SHA-256 bytes, every member is I0 regardless of host or publisher.

adjudication_order: Assign authority from the author's relationship to that claim.
Assign independence from the evidence-producing mechanism, without looking at authority.
Apply the copy-family override last: exact or normalized copies are I0.
Record one level per axis and a short falsifiable rationale.
